hunt.justification: North Korean actors have operationalized AI to scale attacks. This hunt provides the correlation needed to find automated lure delivery and 'agentic' post-exploitation frameworks that individual rules miss.

meta.name: AI-Scaled Social Engineering and Access

related.reason: Existing rules target MCP server exploitation; this hunt looks for broader agentic frameworks like ARTEX.

meta.analysis: A single rule might detect a tool name, but this hunt correlates the automated creation of dozens of PDFs with subsequent high-speed discovery command bursts, providing the context of an AI-scaled operation.

stages.name: AI-Tailored Phishing Lures
observables: PDF lure files created in rapid succession (dozens in minutes)
Job-themed filenames and content (software engineer, recruitment)
Email or outreach referencing spoofed AI-powered blockchain intelligence companies
Tailored recruiter or investor domains used for contact

stages.name: Trojanized Private Repository Lures
observables: Cloned private source code repositories containing trojanized logic
Git activity involving malicious repository lures
Malicious code refactored or generated using AI dev platforms

stages.name: Agentic AI Framework Execution
observables: Process launches for 'ARTEX' agentic AI penetration testing framework
Automated penetration testing commands and scripts launched via AI agents
Execution of commands generated via agentic workflows for reconnaissance and exploitation

stages.name: AI-Assisted Tooling and Persistence
observables: Usage of Cursor AI-assisted development platform for script modification
AI-refactored obfuscation layers in scripts and malware
Commands and scripts troubleshooting errors as observed in command line logs

scenario.summary: North Korean threat actors are leveraging generative and agentic AI to scale reconnaissance, social engineering, and malware development, including the rapid generation of tailored PDF lures and the use of the ARTEX framework for automated penetration testing. These campaigns frequently use fake job-themed personas and front companies to deliver trojanized code via private repositories or initiate malicious interview workflows.

meta.rationale: Focus on hosts belonging to software engineers, blockchain researchers, and recruitment staff. Machines without development tools like git or VS Code are lower priority but should still be scanned for PDF bursts.
meta.hypothesis: An intruder uses generative AI to produce high-volume tailored lures and trojanized repositories, subsequently deploying agentic frameworks like ARTEX for automated reconnaissance and persistence.

references.name: Tracking AI adoption in North Korean threat actor tradecraft

hunt.name: AI-Scaled Social Engineering and Access
hunt.description: This hunt identifies North Korean threat actor tradecraft that incorporates AI as a force multiplier. It begins by identifying automated lure generation (dozens of PDFs created in minutes) and suspicious repository interaction. The hunt then pivots to find evidence of agentic AI frameworks—detecting the automated command bursts typical of ARTEX—and AI-assisted development tools used for persistence.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%git%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%cursor%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%vscode%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%python%')
config.description: Identify hosts with development environments or AI assistants as these are the primary targets for North Korean supply chain and remote-worker operations.
config.expected_signal: Hostnames belonging to developers, researchers, or recruiters. Silence indicates no development software is present in the inventory.

primitive_config.label: Scope development and AI tools
primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE (LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%git%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%cursor%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%vscode%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%python%')
primitive_config.expected: Hostnames belonging to developers, researchers, or recruiters. Silence indicates no development software is present in the inventory.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, COUNT(*) as pdf_count, MIN(time) as first_seen, MAX(time) as last_seen FROM hb_file_activity WHERE LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.pdf' AND (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\\downloads\\%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\\desktop\\%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%/downloads/%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%/desktop/%') AND (instr(',' || '{{lure_keywords}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 OR '{{lure_keywords}}' = '') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname HAVING pdf_count >= 10
config.description: Detect the rapid creation of multiple PDF files in user-writable paths, characteristic of AI-scaled phishing lures.
config.expected_signal: A single host creating 10 or more PDFs in a short window. Silence suggests no automated lure bursts occurred in monitored paths.

primitive_config.label: Automated PDF lure creation bursts
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, COUNT(*) as pdf_count, MIN(time) as first_seen, MAX(time) as last_seen FROM hb_file_activity WHERE LOWER(file_name) LIKE '%.pdf' AND (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\\downloads\\%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%\\desktop\\%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%/downloads/%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%/desktop/%') AND (instr(',' || '{{lure_keywords}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(file_name) || ',') > 0 OR '{{lure_keywords}}' = '') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname HAVING pdf_count >= 10
primitive_config.expected: A single host creating 10 or more PDFs in a short window. Silence suggests no automated lure bursts occurred in monitored paths.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_cmd_line, user_name, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%git%' AND LOWER(process_cmd_line) LIKE '%clone%' AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify git clones from external sources, which may deliver AI-refactored trojanized logic.
config.expected_signal: Users cloning repositories from unusual domains. Silence means no git network activity was recorded on these hosts.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, parent_pid, parent_process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT REPLACE(LOWER(process_name), '.exe', '')) as unique_recon_cmds, MIN(time) as start_time, MAX(time) as end_time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{recon_tools}}' || ',', ',' || REPLACE(LOWER(process_name), '.exe', '') || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, parent_pid HAVING unique_recon_cmds >= 3 AND (strftime('%s', MAX(time)) - strftime('%s', MIN(time))) <= 60
config.description: Identify the agentic footprint of ARTEX by searching for bursts of unique discovery commands from a single parent.
config.expected_signal: A parent process executing 3+ distinct recon tools in 60 seconds. Silence indicates no automated recon bursts were detected.

primitive_config.label: ARTEX agentic command bursts
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, parent_pid, parent_process_name, COUNT(DISTINCT REPLACE(LOWER(process_name), '.exe', '')) as unique_recon_cmds, MIN(time) as start_time, MAX(time) as end_time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{recon_tools}}' || ',', ',' || REPLACE(LOWER(process_name), '.exe', '') || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, parent_pid HAVING unique_recon_cmds >= 3 AND (strftime('%s', MAX(time)) - strftime('%s', MIN(time))) <= 60
primitive_config.expected: A parent process executing 3+ distinct recon tools in 60 seconds. Silence indicates no automated recon bursts were detected.
